messages:
leah: Quick thread  i'm opening a small docs PR to refresh the Quickstart: add a short python SDK snippet, normalize env var names, and fix a bad internal link. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4291.

anzai: can you paste the python snippet here? want to make sure the auth/client shape matches our py SDK docs.

leah: sure, ultra-minimal py example below (async client):
```py
from redwood_inference import Redwood
import os

client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(model='gpt-rt-1', prompt='Hello from Quickstart')
print(resp.text)
```

corrin: looks clean. did you update the Docker and serverless examples to use REDWOOD_API_KEY too? people copy those verbatim.

leah: yep  swapped `REDSYS_TOKEN` -> `REDWOOD_API_KEY` everywhere, updated the docker run snippet to `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY="$REDWOOD_API_KEY" redwood/hello:latest`, and adjusted serverless env docs (Vercel/Netlify examples).

meredith: please add a 2-line migration note for SDK3 -> SDK4 under the bottom of the quickstart. call out that py used to do `client.set_api_key(...)` and now it's `Redwood(api_key=...)`. link to /sdk/migrate.

leah: done. i added a short Migration Notes section with the two-line example and the migrate link. also fixed a broken anchor that was pointing to `/guides/auth#old-heading`  now points to `/guides/auth#token-best-practices`.

build-bot: ci:docs  lint & linkcheck passed for PR #4291 :white_check_mark:

anzai: tiny nit  prefer `prompt` key in examples to keep parity across languages (we still have some pages using `input`). i'll push a one-line commit to normalize.

leah: thanks  go ahead and push the tweak. i'll wait for your approval + CI before merging.

corrin: i'll run the quickstart locally (docker + serverless) after the tweak to make sure nothing regresses.

build-bot: publish:docs scheduled  staging will pick up the change in ~7m after merge.
